facts.fact: Ministry of Finance officials confirmed on 7 January 2026 that no comprehensive disaster-recovery system is yet in place for the national e-GP platform hosted in the Ministry's data centre; disaster recovery is planned for Phase Two (Ministry framework or cloud). Main site place not stated; no backup site.
